name: The Cheesecake Love Affair
source:
"Finding love between cappuccinos and cheesecakes? No thanks!"

The last thing you want is falling in love. After a terrible incident shattered your heart, you are determined to eat ice cream alone all summer long to heal your wounds and above all: start over at your uncle Mac's house in Oakfall. To do this, you find yourself a little job in the local café. Simple, uncomplicated, close to cheesecakes just waiting for you: what a dream!

Except that there are two (all) little things that you hadn't planned: your colleagues! Between Ren, with solar charm but a heavy past, and Kai, a distant young man with a teasing smile, you don't know where to turn to. Can you unlock their secrets? And then, more importantly: will you be able to hide yours from them?

[Translated from [url=https://roseromancegames.itch.io/cheesecake-love-affair]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「在卡布奇諾與起司蛋糕之間邂逅愛情？謝了，不必！」

談戀愛是你最不想碰的事。在一場糟糕的變故擊碎了你的心之後，你下定決心整個夏天都要獨自吃著冰淇淋療傷，而最重要的是：去奧克福爾的麥克舅舅家重新開始。為此，你在當地咖啡館找了一份小兼職。簡單純粹、一點也不複雜，身邊還有彷彿正等著你享用的起司蛋糕：簡直跟做夢一樣！

只不過，有兩件「小」事完全超出了你的計畫：你的同事們！一邊是魅力如陽光般耀眼、卻背負著沉重過去的蓮，另一邊是帶著戲謔笑容、性情疏離的青年凱，你不知該如何是好。你能揭開他們的秘密嗎？更重要的是——你能在他們面前藏好自己的秘密嗎？

[譯自[url=https://roseromancegames.itch.io/cheesecake-love-affair]Itch.io[/url]]
